descriptions.zh: 我们的能量币赤字已经失控！[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]要求我们采取有效措施控制事态，否则将会在数月之后大幅削减开支。
descriptions.en: Our energy deficit is out of control! [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] demands that we take drastic action to take hold of the situation, failing which severe cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months.

descriptions.zh: 我们的能量币赤字已经失控！我们的资源分配子个体面对我们补给线健康度的读数时愈发地焦虑不安了。它们预计，如果无法采取有效行动，在数月之后必须要大幅削减开支。
descriptions.en: Our energy deficit is out of control! Our resource distribution drones are increasingly agitated at the readings they measure on the health of our supply lines. They forecast that drastic cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months unless significant action is taken.

label.zh: 我们可以从支持者那里借一点。
label.en: We can borrow from our supporters.
Everything is going according to plan.

options.script: name = deficit.100.C

descriptions.zh: 我们没能避免破产。经历了数月的能量币短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能拖欠债务并大幅削减开支。
descriptions.en: We have failed to stave off bankruptcy. Following months of energy shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to default on our debts and make sharp cutbacks to our expenditures.

descriptions.zh: 我们没能平衡收支。经历了数月的能量币短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能对我们的资源分发系统强制执行大规模重组。
descriptions.en: We have failed to rebalance our expenditures. Following months of energy shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to enforce large-scale reallocations to our resource distribution systems.

descriptions.zh: 我们帝国的矿物短缺在最近数月来愈发严峻。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]对前景的预期从担忧转为愤怒，这表明我们很快就会用尽偿还债务的资源。他们预测，除非采取重大行动，否则在数月之后必须要大幅削减开支。
descriptions.en: Our empire's mineral shortages have become increasingly severe in recent months. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] has progressed from concerned to irate at the current forecasts, which suggest that we will soon run out of resources to pay off our debts. They predict that drastic cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months unless significant action is taken.

descriptions.zh: 我们帝国的矿物短缺在最近数月来愈发严峻。我们的资源分配子个体已经竭尽全力，仍然无法保证我们的后勤系统不崩溃。他们预测，除非采取重大行动，否则在数月之后必须要大幅削减开支。
descriptions.en: Our empire's mineral shortages have become increasingly severe in recent months. Our resource allocation drones are stretched to the limit, and are unable to guarantee against a breakdown of our logistics systems. They forecast that drastic cutbacks will be necessary in a matter of months unless significant action is taken.

tooltips.zh: 关闭全部的克隆仓。我们就不再需要支出相应的维护费了。
tooltips.en: All active Clone Vats are disabled. We will no longer have to pay their upkeep.

label.zh: 我们可以从支持者那里借一点。
label.en: We can borrow from our supporters.
Everything is going according to plan.

options.script: name = deficit.100.C

descriptions.zh: 我们没能避免破产。经历了数月的矿物极度短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能拖欠债务并大幅削减开支。
descriptions.en: We have failed to stave off bankruptcy. Following months of mineral shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to default on our debts and make sharp cutbacks to our expenditures.

descriptions.zh: 我们没能平衡收支。经历了数月的矿物短缺之后，我们别无选择，只能对我们的资源分发系统强制执行大规模重组。
descriptions.en: We have failed to rebalance our expenditures. Following months of mineral shortages that have become terminal, we have had no choice but to enforce large-scale reallocations to our resource distribution systems.

descriptions.zh: 我们帝国面临的食物短缺问题正变得越来越严重。显然我们必须采取果断行动，否则短缺将在几个月内达到极限。
descriptions.en: The food shortages befalling our empire are becoming increasingly problematic. It is clear that we will have to take decisive action, otherwise the shortages will become terminal within a matter of months.

tooltips.zh: 关闭全部的克隆仓。我们就不再需要支出相应的维护费了。
tooltips.en: All active Clone Vats are disabled. We will no longer have to pay their upkeep.

tooltips.zh: 关闭全部的生物反应堆。我们就不再需要支出相应的维护费了。
tooltips.en: All active Bio-Reactors are disabled. We will no longer have to pay their upkeep.

label.en: Everything is going according to plan.

options.script: name = deficit.100.C

descriptions.zh: 我们的食物债务已经无可救药。大幅削减将会强制执行，我们将别无选择接受破产并重组我们的契约。
descriptions.en: Our food debt has become terminal. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, as we have no choice but to accept bankruptcy and default on our obligations.

descriptions.zh: 我们的食物耗尽了。我们无法再为子个体或其他需要食物以维持运转的实体提供给养。大幅削减将会强制执行，我们别无选择，只能对我们的资源分发系统强制执行大规模重组。
descriptions.en: Our food has run out. We simply cannot provide any sustenance to the drones and other entities that require it to function. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, as we have no choice but to make large-scale reallocations to our resource distribution system.

descriptions.zh: 我们或许最珍视之物——自然资源的平衡——已经失守。我们的给养储备已经耗尽，导致整个食物链陷入困境。为了确保最大的生存机会，我们现在必须采取严厉的配给制和大规模的资源重新分配。
descriptions.en: That which we perhaps hold most precious - the balance of our natural resources - has failed. Our feed stocks have run out, causing distress throughout the food web. We must now resort to harsh rationing and large-scale reallocation of resources in order to ensure the greatest chance for survival.

descriptions.zh: 消费品的短缺导致[Root.Owner.GetName]境内生活水平的严重下滑。不满的声音日益显现，采取紧急行动的呼吁越来越广泛，很明显，供应的完全崩溃只有数月之遥了。
descriptions.en: The shortages of consumer goods have led to a precipitous drop in living standards within the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Voices of discontent are growing ever stronger, and urgent calls to action are increasingly widespread as it becomes clear that a total breakdown in supplies is only months away.

descriptions.zh: 消费品的短缺导致了[Root.Owner.GetName]内非格式塔生物的生活水平大幅下跌。不满的声音日益显现，采取紧急行动的呼吁越来越广泛，很明显，供应的完全崩溃只有数月之遥了。
descriptions.en: Shortages of consumer goods have led to a precipitous drop in living standards for the individualistic life forms living within the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Voices of discontent are growing ever stronger, as our logistics drones warn that a total breakdown in supplies is only months away.

label.zh: 我们可以从支持者那里借一点。
label.en: We can borrow from our supporters.

label.zh: 我们得勒紧裤腰带了，制定配给制度。
label.en: Hard times are upon us. Institute rationing.
Everything is going according to plan.

options.script: name = deficit.100.C

descriptions.zh: 我们的消费品短缺已经严重到没有任何切合实际的办法能够弥补。大幅削减将会强制执行，我们将别无选择接受破产并重组我们的契约。
descriptions.en: Consumer goods shortages have increased to the point that there is no realistic way our deficits can be recouped. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, as we have no choice but to accept bankruptcy and default on our obligations.

descriptions.zh: [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]现在愈发关心我们帝国发生的合金短缺。如果不能尽快弥补上我们的支出，我们的工业部门将会收到广泛的影响。
descriptions.en: [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is getting increasingly concerned about the alloy shortage befalling our empire. Failure to recoup our expenses will bring widespread disruptions to our industry sector.

descriptions.zh: 预算警告：当前合金支出已经超过了接下来数月的支出阈值。若不能解决短缺，将会给我们的工业区域造成广泛的扰乱。
descriptions.en: Budget warning: alloy expenditures surpassing expenditures for multiple subsequent months. Failure to resolve the shortage will bring widespread disruptions to our industry sector.

tooltips.zh: 拆解[robots_planet.GetName]上的所有机器人（£pop£§H[robots_planet.recycled_robots]子个体§!）以获取£alloys£§Y[robots_planet.total_alloys_gained]合金§!
tooltips.en: Dismantle all robots on [robots_planet.GetName] (£pop£ §H[robots_planet.recycled_robots] Drones§!) to gain £alloys£ §Y[robots_planet.total_alloys_gained] Alloys§!

label.zh: 合并。循环。拆解§Y[robots_planet.GetName]§!上的智能人。

tooltips.zh: 拆解[robots_planet.GetName]上的一半人口（£pop£§H[robots_planet.recycled_robots]子个体§!）以获取£alloys£§Y[robots_planet.total_alloys_gained]合金§!
tooltips.en: Dismantle half of the population on [robots_planet.GetName] (£pop£ §H[robots_planet.recycled_robots] Drones§!) to gain £alloys£ §Y[robots_planet.total_alloys_gained] Alloys§!

label.en: Everything is going according to plan.

options.script: name = deficit.100.C

descriptions.zh: 由于无法解决合金短缺，我们被迫宣布破产并违约债务。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
descriptions.en: Having failed to resolve our alloys shortage, we have been forced to declare bankruptcy and default on our debts. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new austerity plan to cut expenses and preventing this situation from ever happening again.

descriptions.zh: 稀有水晶在[Root.Owner.GetName]变得更加稀有了。包括关键的军用器材和先进生产设施中的核心组件，几乎各行各业都发生了短缺。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]提醒，必须在数月之内重整补给链，否则将需要大幅削减开支。
descriptions.en: Rare crystals are becoming increasingly scarce in the [Root.Owner.GetName]. Shortages have been reported in many fields, ranging from vital military supplies to critical components used in many advanced manufacturing processes. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] warns reforms to the supply chain will be necessary within a matter of months, failing which sharp cutbacks will be necessary.

label.zh: 从首都方舟抽取稀有水晶。
label.en: Siphon rare crystals from the Capital Arkship.

label.zh: 或许我们需要竭尽开采资源。
label.en: We will have to overexploit our deposits.

label.zh: 我们可以忍受“超稀有”水晶。
label.en: We can live with our crystals being rarer.

options.script: name = deficit.185.C

descriptions.zh: 我们稀有水晶的供给已经枯竭到即使关键系统都无法获得补充。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]调侃道如今它已经可以称呼为“极稀有”水晶了，他同时还强制执行了急剧的削减以期能恢复收支平衡。
descriptions.en: Our supply of rare crystals has diminished to the point that even critical systems can no longer be supported. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap], which recommends that they be renamed to "rarest crystals", is enforcing harsh cutbacks to return our usage of them to sustainable levels.

descriptions.zh:
我们的稀有水晶储备已消耗到无法维持多项关键功能的程度。在极端情况下，我们那些依赖这种珍贵资源的特化共生体将面临生命危险。

为避免进一步的生命损失和生产力下滑，我们现在必须采取极端手段来确保系统重新恢复平衡。
descriptions.en:
Our supply of Rare Crystals has diminished to the point we can no longer maintain several critical functions. In extreme instances, we risk the lives of our more specialized symbionts who depend on this precious resource.

To prevent further loss of life and productivity, we must now rely on drastic means to ensure we once again reach equilibrium.

descriptions.zh: 由于管理缺失和大肆的浪费，我们的易爆微粒库存已经完全枯竭！这种战略资源在包括合金冶炼和军事发展等诸多领域有着广泛的应用。尽快补充库存对确保我们帝国经济繁荣至关重要。
descriptions.en: Due to mismanagement and reckless expenditures, our Volatile Motes reserves have completely evaporated! This strategic resource is widely used in multiple fields, ranging from alloys production to military development. Replenishing our supplies is of paramount importance to ensure the economic prosperity of our empire.

label.zh: 从首都方舟抽取易爆微粒。
label.en: Siphon volatile motes from the Capital Arkship.

label.zh: 或许我们需要竭尽开采资源。
label.en: We will have to overexploit our deposits.

label.zh: 我们可以忍受“超罕见”微粒。
label.en: We can live with our motes becoming more elusive.

options.script: name = deficit.200.C

descriptions.zh: 长期的易爆微粒短缺导致了一场全国性的经济危机。由于无法弥补赤字，我们被迫宣布破产并违约债务。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
descriptions.en: The long-running shortage of volatile motes resulted in an empire-wide economic crash. Unable to repay our deficits, we were forced to declare bankruptcy and forfeit on our debts. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new financial plan, enforcing harsh cutback to rebalance our budget.

descriptions.zh: 长期的易爆微粒短缺导致了一场全国性的补给链崩溃。很显然我们已经无法继续维持我们对该物质的消耗。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]正在起草新的紧缩经济计划以削减开支，避免这种情况再度发生。
descriptions.en: The long-running shortage of volatile motes resulted in an empire-wide supply chain crash. It has become clear that we can no longer sustain our use of this material. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] is drafting a new financial plan, enforcing harsh cutback to rebalance our budget.

descriptions.zh: 我们各世界之间易爆微粒的短缺已造成广泛的混乱，尤其是那些生命完全依赖于它的极端微生物共生体。为了防止生命和生产力的进一步损失，我们现在必须实行剧烈的变革，以确保基本生命的延续，希望我们能尽快恢复平衡。
descriptions.en: The shortage of Volatile Motes among our worlds has caused widespread disruption, not least to those extremophile worker-symbionts whose very lives depend on it. To prevent further loss of life and productivity, we must now institute drastic change to ensure basic continuity of life, in the hopes we might soon regain equilibrium.

descriptions.zh: 异星天然气在我们的国库中已经成了稀罕货——而它们的长期缺失对我们所有依赖它的生产流程都产生了严重的影响。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]强烈建议我们重新考虑预算优先级，以结束这一怪异的局势。
descriptions.en: Exotic Gases have become a foreign presence in our empire stockpile - and their continued absence is having an impact on our entire manufacturing process, which heavily depends on them. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] strongly suggests we reconsider our budget priorities to put an end to this outlandish situation.

label.zh: 从首都方舟抽取异星天然气。
label.en: Siphon exotic gases from the Capital Arkship.

label.zh: 或许我们需要竭尽开采资源。
label.en: We will have to overexploit our deposits.

label.zh: 我们可以忍受“超难得”天然气。
label.en: We can live with our gases being more fleeting.

options.script: name = deficit.215.C

descriptions.zh: 我们的帝国已经再也无法应付异星天然气短缺对我们生产流程的毁灭性打击。[Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap]被迫宣布破产，使我们得以违约债务。新的紧缩经济计划正在起草以削减开支，这样一来我们就可以逐渐重建我们的资源储备。
descriptions.en: Our empire can no longer cope with the exotic gas shortages that have been disrupting our manufacturing processes. [Owner.GetFinancialAdvisorAgencyCap] has been forced to declare bankruptcy, allowing us to forfeit our debts. Sharp cutbacks will be enforced, so that we may slowly rebuild our resource stockpile.
